title: Thirty-Three
text: Thirty-three hulls, three rows, one empty berth with our name on it. The drones have mapped every one. The plates point at Vess, Halcyon's moon, and so does a routing entry in the relay. A new route is on the Gantry's card.

choices.label: Head home
choices.reply: The lander lifts. Below it the rows keep their order.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: We stay among the rows. Nobody says much on the channel.

notes: onDone of hull-field. The Act 2 "Expedition complete" card: Return to Touchdown travels home; Stay keeps playing here.
